name.fr-FR: Le Contrat de l’homme avec Dieu par le saint Baptême
name.en-US: Man’s Contract with God in Baptism
name.pt-BR: O Contrato do homem com Deus pelo santo Batismo

description.fr-FR: Le traité sur les promesses du Baptême, avec l’exercice de renouvellement.
description.en-US: The treatise on the promises of Baptism, with the exercise of renewal.
description.pt-BR: O tratado sobre as promessas do Batismo, com o exercício de renovação.

fr-FR.editor: Charles Lebrun, Ange Le Doré, Joseph Dauphin (Congrégation de Jésus et Marie)

sources.edition: Œuvres complètes du Vénérable Jean Eudes, tome 2, Vannes (Lafolye) et Paris (Beauchesne), 1905–1911, éd. Ch. Lebrun, A. Le Doré, J. Dauphin; transcription Bibliothèque Saint Libère (liberius.net), 2008.
sources.description: Born-digital transcription of the 1905–11 edition, converted by script: page markers and running heads removed, hyphenation and leaked letter-spacing repaired, paragraphs rejoined; the editors’ footnotes are gathered at the end of the file where they fall; footnote call numbers stay in the running text. The editors’ introductions are kept.
sources.tierEvidence: Eudes died in 1680; the 1905–11 edition is public domain.
